states: Production vite build of this tree compared with the build of its parent 19558f955d: after normalising chunk-name hashes, SRI hashes and 1-3 character minified identifiers, every dist file is identical except the shared chunk carrying ChartsAPI, which differs only by the removed never-called getInfrastructureCharts static method (99 bytes); the other removed exports were already tree-shaken. Served embedded by a private DEMO_MODE mock backend on port 7763

Proxmox overview at 1440: node table plus grouped guests table; clicking the Analytics A node name focuses the "Guests on Analytics A" heading inside the viewport and the node row carries data-summary-row-active=true
Guest row hover sets data-summary-row-active=true; workload group header hover stays inert (Proxmox mounts WorkloadsSurface with groupNodeDrawerMode disabled, unchanged)
Guest inline detail ([data-inline-detail-for]) opens with its top inside the viewport at 1440 and 390 without moving the page scroll

Proxmox storage pools at 1440: Growth (24h) column renders values on 72 pool rows from the storage summary history cache; pool row hover sets data-summary-row-active=true; pool inline detail opens in view at 1440 and 390

Storage grouped by node: pool-group header hover marks 2 member pools data-summary-group-member-active=preview; header click pins the group scope (header stays active after the pointer leaves) and Escape clears it
No page errors; the only failed request is the Pro-gated /api/usage/workload-history (403 on this community-tier stack), which no file in this change touches
interactions: Demo auto sign-in, then direct navigation to /proxmox, /proxmox/storage and /proxmox/storage?group=node
Clicked a node name in the Proxmox node table, hovered and clicked a guest row, hovered a workload group header
Hovered and clicked a storage pool row, hovered and clicked a pool-group header, moved the pointer away, pressed Escape
